summary: Re-test of the 5 bulk-approve scenarios blocked in iteration_47 due to missing seed. Seed packets zzbulk-A, zzbulk-B (cover_review), zzbulk-C are now present. All 5 scenarios PASS end-to-end on the live Preview as admin usvopp@yahoo.com. Bulk approve flow (select-all excludes cover_review, confirm list, cancel preserves state, submit approves 2, result modal, chip count decrements, A/C become Complete, B remains Draft with Ready to approve badge) works exactly per spec.

validated_scenarios.row_checkboxes_vs_individual: PASS - zzbulk-A and zzbulk-C render [data-testid=bulk-select-zzbulk-A|C]; zzbulk-B renders [data-testid=bulk-individual-zzbulk-B] with exact text 'Approve individually' and no checkbox. Clicking the A checkbox did NOT open the detail panel ([data-testid=claim-detail] count stayed 0).
validated_scenarios.select_all_and_approve_button: PASS - [data-testid=bulk-select-all] selects exactly bulk-select-zzbulk-A and bulk-select-zzbulk-C (B excluded). Button [data-testid=bulk-approve-btn] text 'Approve selected (2)', not disabled.
validated_scenarios.confirm_modal_cancel: PASS - [data-testid=bulk-confirm-list] text = 'ZZTEST Bulk AZZTEST Bulk C' (both names shown). [data-testid=bulk-confirm-cancel] closes modal without approving (A still appears in Ready to approve filter afterwards).
validated_scenarios.confirm_submit_result: PASS - [data-testid=bulk-confirm-submit] triggers approval; [data-testid=bulk-result-approved] shows 'Approved: 2'. After [data-testid=bulk-result-close], chip count drops from 3 to 1.
validated_scenarios.a_c_show_complete_under_all: PASS - under All filter, row zzbulk-A and zzbulk-C both show 'Complete' badge; zzbulk-B still shows 'Draft | Ready To Approve'.
validated_scenarios.b_still_draft_with_ready_badge: PASS - [data-testid=claim-open-zzbulk-B] opens detail showing Status 'Draft' with [data-testid=claim-ready-badge] visible ('Ready to approve').

critical_code_review_comments: Confirmed from iteration_47 code review: bulkEligible = p.ready_to_approve && !p.cover_review correctly excludes cover_review packets.
Checkbox wrapper's e.stopPropagation() correctly prevents row-click opening detail - verified live.
Modal onClose guarded by bulkBusy - no accidental dismissal during request.
seed_data_creation: None - zzbulk-A/B/C were already seeded by main agent prior to this run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature fully verified. zzbulk-A and zzbulk-C have been APPROVED (Complete) during this test; zzbulk-B is still Draft with ready_to_approve=true & cover_review=true. If re-testing, main agent needs to reset A and C to draft/ready_to_approve again before re-running the bulk flow.
rca of the issue: N/A - prior blocker (missing seed) is resolved.
